# Automatic Cow

> Automatic Cow is a weekly **local beef delivery** service in **Houston, Texas**.
> Customers choose their cuts, set how many pounds they want each week, and we
> deliver fresh, locally-sourced beef to their door every Saturday. Priced by the
> pound. Cancel anytime.

## What we sell (priced per pound)

Steaks:
- Bone-in Ribeye — $31.99/lb
- New York Strip — $27.99/lb
- Filet — $39.99/lb
- Sirloin — $19.99/lb
- Round Steak / Cutlets — $14.99/lb
- Flank / Skirt — $24.99/lb

Roasts / Slow Cuts:
- Roasts — $14.99/lb
- Brisket — $14.99/lb

Ground Beef:
- Ground Beef — $12.99/lb

## How it works

1. Pick your building / delivery location in Houston.
2. Choose your cuts and how many pounds of each you want per week.
3. The site calculates your weekly price instantly (price per pound × pounds).
4. We deliver every Saturday. Local beef, weekly delivery, cancel anytime.

## Service area

Houston, Texas — including Upper Kirby, River Oaks, Montrose, Downtown,
Uptown / Galleria, The Heights, and Midtown.
